title: John Fitch Steamboat Museum
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: John Fitch Steamboat Museum, Inc. is a non-profit organization in association with the Craven Hall Historical Society, Inc., whose mission was to establish a museum that would house exhibits depicting the adventuresome life of John Fitch and the steamboat that he invented.
